title: Plan View PDF upload keep + folder move identity
description:
Desktop Upload PDFs / Push was writing plan library rows with a valid Wasabi storageKey but empty pieces; the server sanitize step dropped those rows, so push looked successful while the PDF never appeared in Plan View. Persist now keeps whole-PDF archives (synthesizes a single piece from storageKey). Folder moves keep the same storageKey/id and use folderUpdatedAt so a later Push does not undo a server-side move.

Who is affected: anyone uploading or pushing PDFs into PipeSync Plan View from Desktop or the web library.
changeLog: Sanitize legacyPlans: keep docs with archive storageKey even when pieces[] is empty (synthesize one piece)
Union-merge folderId by folderUpdatedAt (else prefer server) so portal moves survive local Push
Web Plan View folder moves stamp folderUpdatedAt
